facts.fact: Ordonnance n°2025-009/PT-RM of 14 February 2025 creates the Agence nationale de Sécurisation des Actes d'Etat civil (ANSAEC), a national public administrative establishment, to identify electronic means for, design, produce and authenticate civil status acts, and to develop, maintain and evolve the systems, equipment and networks that manage them; it takes over the renovated technical platform and the staff of the Centre de Traitement des Données de l'Etat civil, whose 2013 law is repealed.
facts.system: systèmes informatiques permettant la gestion des Actes d'Etat civil (ANSAEC)

facts.fact: The same ordinance of 14 February 2025 gives ANSAEC an initial endowment from the State and lists its resources as service revenues, State subsidies, partner contributions, gifts and legacies, loans and sundry resources; it states no amount and names no budget line.
facts.system: systèmes informatiques permettant la gestion des Actes d'Etat civil (ANSAEC)

systems.system: systèmes informatiques permettant la gestion des Actes d'Etat civil (ANSAEC)
systems.country_label: Agence nationale de Sécurisation des Actes d'Etat civil (ANSAEC)
systems.platform: the renovated technical platform of the former Centre de Traitement des Données de l'Etat civil
systems.owner: ANSAEC, a public administrative establishment; the ordinance is countersigned by the minister of territorial administration
systems.tiers: not stated; the ordinance does not say where or by whom an act is entered

systems.country_label: RNIP; système intégré et sécurisé de gestion du répertoire national d'identification des Personnes
systems.owner: ANSAEC designs and administers its applications
systems.tiers: national: biographic and biometric data of all persons living or having stayed in the country, the biographic data coming from the Registre national de l'Etat civil

systems.country_label: Recensement administratif à Vocation d'Etat civil (RAVEC)
systems.tiers: the database against which a mairie or civil status service checks an act when authenticating it

defined as a secured technical mechanism of exchange between citizen identification subsystems on a shared unique identifier; ANSAEC is to ensure it between the bodies involved in delivering civil status acts and with third-party subsystems

systems.system: Centre de Traitement des Données de l'Etat civil (CTDEC)
systems.owner: abolished: Loi n°2013-008 of 6 May 2013 repealed, assets and staff passed to ANSAEC

note: The whole issue of the Journal officiel was read; only the ordinance at pp. 162-164 is in the study's field. It is an institutional text: it says nothing of which offices enter records, how, or for which events. The finance row is recorded as domestic on a statutory list of resources that also includes partners, with no budget line: the parent should weigh it accordingly.
